comparison.objective: Pack a power bank and spare battery in carry-on luggage rather than checked luggage; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Object selection and bag placement versus precision tool alignment, bimanual striking and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both battery items must be in the carry-on, not the checked bag; detailed thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four safe fractures and no lost tangs.
comparison.reason: Selective packing shares only generic pick-and-place primitives with the candidate.
